name: Zepho
overview: Zepho, also known as Zephi, is identified in Scripture as one of the sons of Eliphaz, who was the firstborn son of Esau. The genealogies in Genesis 36 and 1 Chronicles 1 list Zepho among the chief descendants, highlighting his role within the Edomite lineage. These passages emphasize the continuity of Esau's family line and the establishment of leadership among his descendants.
